purpose: Multi-scenario stress testing across 6 historical crisis scenarios (GFC 2008, COVID Mar 2020, Dot-com Bust, Lehman Week, Rate Shock 2022, SVB Contagion 2023) with Monte Carlo per scenario. Equity/credit/rate factor decomposition, stressed VaR and ES, stress multiplier, recovery-day estimate. Chains from QFA-02 (VaR Engine). Feeds RCA-01 (FRTB IMA). Basel 3.1 Pillar 2 ICAAP / EBA GL/2018/04 / FRTB MAR30 stress calibration reference.
